description: This is a shell script designed to run various stress tests on a device. It sources device properties, sets up environment variables, manages and executes multiple stress-ng workload tests (CPU, memory, disk I/O, scheduler, network, etc.), logs system metrics, and uploads logs at the end.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to a log file.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Performs cleanup activities such as stopping metrics capture and removing the workspace.

methods.name: logUptime
methods.description: Logs the system uptime to the log file.

methods.name: logMem
methods.description: Logs the system memory details via the free command.

methods.name: execAndRedirectOut
methods.description: Executes a command, logs the start and end of execution, along with system uptime/memory info, and redirects output to the log file.
